data.text: The staged plan 'Stock 2w now, price +3% wk 8' dominates every scenario: 100% better than Do Nothing in all five futures, positive in every bad case (worst +1.1k), steady gain +3.3k, and only $4.6k extra cash tied up (well under $12k). Its weak spot is trivial (storage cost -0.1k).

This plan wins in every future — mean and 1-in-20 bad case — including the competitive shocks (new rivals, rival price cut). It locks in 2 weeks of cheap beans now, then raises price modestly when that stock runs out (week 8). Extra cash tied up is only $4.6k. The worst bad case still adds $1.1k vs.

data.headline: Add 2 weeks of stock now, raise price 3% in week 8
data.why: News confirms Arabica prices at a one-month high and roasters buying physical beans at higher prices. Locking in 2 extra weeks of inventory now at current cost shields 60% of your bean cost from further increases. A modest 3% price lift in week 8 passes through the expected cost pressure without losing price-sensitive café and grocery accounts.
data.watch_out: If Arabica prices reverse before week 8, you carry higher-cost inventory and a price increase that may push volume to the $12.50 rival. The bad case is margin compression on both sides
data.recheck_when: Watch the next USDA coffee report and ICE Arabica futures settlement; re-evaluate if futures drop below the late-August low
